Key.English: Log HUD diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.

Key.English: HUD Debug Log

Key.Original: Transmit plus receive antenna gain, dBi. 0 is isotropic; a body-worn whip is typically below it.

Key.Original: Show your group as a real tracker would: each unit's own GPS solution (the real constellation at the mission date, blocked by terrain and buildings), sent on the ATAK reporting schedule over a radio link that must close over the terrain. Draws each report with its error ellipse on the map and the HUD. Default off.
Key.English: Show your group as a real tracker would: each unit's own GPS solution (the real constellation at the mission date, blocked by terrain and buildings), sent on the ATAK reporting schedule over a radio link that must close over the terrain. Draws each report with its error ellipse on the map and the HUD. Default off.

Key.English: Signal Tracker

Key.Original: Datalink Frequency (MHz)
Key.English: Datalink Frequency (MHz)

Key.English: Seconds between tracker model updates for the local group, range 0.2 to 5. A longer interval costs less and ages the tracks more. Default 1.0.

Key.English: Report Interval, Fast (s)

Key.English: Report Interval, Stationary (s)
